an7.78:1.1: Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hoti.
an7.78:1.7: anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathīdaṃ ekam pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo . . . pe . . . iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati,
an7.78:1.8: dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena . . . yathākammūpage satte pajānāti,
an7.78:1.9: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ ditth' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.78:1.10: Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hotī
